gloss_en: I want to go to the cinema now
notes: [daily] French donor: cinema→sinama (o2i donor=fr-FR); pipeline reads Latin as en-GB→sinima. French is N'Djamena's live CS matrix; Chadian French loan layer (pommerol1999). qaf→[ɡ] frame داير 'wanting'/هسع 'now' (owens1993; owens2006).

gloss_en: I went to the pharmacy to buy medicine
notes: [daily] French donor: pharmacie→faɣmasi (o2i donor=fr-FR, ʁ→ɣ); pipeline en-GB→faːrmasiː. French loan layer of Chadian Arabic (pommerol1999).

gloss_en: my mother cooks in the kitchen
notes: [daily] French donor: cuisine→kwizin (o2i donor=fr-FR); pipeline en-GB→kuːzin. Chadian French domestic-register loan (pommerol1999).

gloss_en: this service is not good
notes: [commerce] French donor: service→saɣfis (o2i donor=fr-FR, ʁ→ɣ); pipeline en-GB→sarfis. دا demonstrative + ما-negation, Sudanic-chain frame (owens1993). French CS matrix (pommerol1999).

gloss_en: this door is automatic
notes: [tech] French donor: automatique→atəmatik (o2i donor=fr-FR); pipeline en-GB→aatumatikw. French technical loan layer (pommerol1999).

gloss_en: I want to see a doctor now
notes: [daily] French donor: docteur→dəkti (o2i donor=fr-FR, final r dropped); pipeline en-GB→duktiar. داير 'I want' + هسع 'now' (owens1993). French loan layer (pommerol1999).

gloss_en: I have a new laptop but it is slow
notes: [tech] English loan laptop→labtub (/p/→[b], no /p/ in inventory); en-GB donor, default pan-Arabic table (Watson 2002; Holes 2004). English is the younger tech-register CS layer alongside French.

gloss_en: I want to send an email to the manager
notes: [tech] English loan email→imiːl (West Sudanic has no mid /eː/; total nativisation projects to nearest [iː], no drop). en-GB donor, default pan-Arabic table (Watson 2002; Holes 2004). qaf→[ɡ] daːjir frame (owens1993).

gloss_en: I paid cash not card
notes: [commerce] English loans cash→kaʃ; card→kaːrd. ما-negation, Sudanic chain (owens1993). en-GB donor, default pan-Arabic table (Watson 2002; Holes 2004).

gloss_en: I have an important meeting with a manager
notes: [work] English loans meeting→miːtinɡ (/ŋ/→[nɡ], /ɡ/ in inventory via qaf→[ɡ]); manager→manadʒar (jīm/loan /dʒ/, ~[ɟ] palatal variant; owens1993/2006). en-GB donor, default pan-Arabic table (Watson 2002; Holes 2004).

gloss_en: I watched a video at home today
notes: [daily] English loan video→fidiu (/v/→[f]). URBAN N'DJAMENA MONOPHTHONGISATION: sedentary/urban Chadian raises */aj aw/→[eː oː], so بيت→[beːt], يوم→[joːm] (Roth-Laly 1979 for Abeche; Kaye 1976). The spec models the diphthong-RETAINING Bedouin West Sudanic mainline (owens1993), so the pipeline keeps the diphthongs and emits 'ˈʃuft fidiu ˈfiː ˈlbajt aˈljawm'. Urban form pinned with beːt/joːm. default pan-Arabic table.

gloss_en: where is my printer
notes: [tech] English loan printer→brintar (/p/→[b]). URBAN N'DJAMENA MONOPHTHONGISATION: وَين→[weːn], the spec retains the diphthong (Bedouin type; owens1993) so the pipeline emits 'ˈwajn brintar biˈtaːʕiː'; urban sedentary [weːn] (Roth-Laly 1979; Kaye 1976) pinned. genitive exponent بتاعي. default pan-Arabic table.

gloss_en: I have a new telephone
notes: [tech] French-layer loan تلفون 'telephone' (<Fr. téléphone; pommerol1999); attested [tilifoːn]. PIPELINE WRONG: emits 'tiliˈfuːn' — reads و as [uː] not the loan mid vowel [oː]. Correct loan IPA pinned. default pan-Arabic table.

gloss_en: I took a taxi to the market
notes: [automotive] French-layer loan تاكسي 'taxi' (<Fr. taxi; pommerol1999) → taːksi, matches attested [taːksi]. Pipeline reads the vocalised loan natively and matches. سوق→[suːɡ] shows qaf→[ɡ] (owens1993). default pan-Arabic table.

gloss_en: my mother is in the kitchen
notes: [daily] French-layer loan كوزينة 'kitchen' (<Fr. cuisine; pommerol1999). Pipeline emits a stress+length artifact 'lkuˈːziːna'; attested realisation /kuˈziːna/ pinned. default pan-Arabic table.

gloss_en: the car has no petrol
notes: [automotive] French-layer loan أسانس 'petrol' (<Fr. essence; pommerol1999) → ʔasaːns, matches attested [asaːns]. Pipeline reads the vocalised loan natively and matches. ما فيها 'it hasn't' negation. default pan-Arabic table.

gloss_en: I have a new television in the room
notes: [daily] French-layer loan تلفزيون 'television' (<Fr. télévision; pommerol1999); attested [tilifizjoːn]. PIPELINE WRONG: emits 'tilifiˈzjuːn' — reads و as [uː] instead of the loan mid vowel [oː]. Correct loan IPA pinned. default pan-Arabic table.

gloss_en: how are you, man?
notes: [arabizi] Latin-script Chadian (7=ح/ħ; zol 'man/person', shared West-Sudanic/Sudanese lexeme). Spells كيف حالك يا زول؟ Pipeline has no Arabizi path; ipa hand-derived as the urban N'Djamena reading with monophthong كيف→[keːf], زول→[zoːl] (Roth-Laly 1979; Kaye 1976). table: n/a

gloss_en: where did you go yesterday
notes: [arabizi] Latin-script Chadian (7=ح/ħ). Spells وَين مَشَيت أَمْبارِح. Pipeline has no Arabizi path; ipa hand-derived as the urban reading with monophthong وين→[weːn], مشيت→[maʃeːt] (Roth-Laly 1979; Kaye 1976). table: n/a

gloss_en: do you have anything new?
notes: [arabizi] Latin-script Chadian (3=ع/ʕ, 7=ح/ħ, j=ج). Spells عِندَك حاجة جْديدة؟ Pipeline has no Arabizi path; ipa hand-derived as the Chadian reading; jīm→[dʒ] (~[ɟ]; owens1993/2006). table: n/a
